retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, hand-painted folk-art composition featuring a large central blue spiral disk surrounded by four rectangular vignettes and a multi-layered geometric border.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist digital vectors are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a large, hand-painted blue circle with a subtle spiral texture. The circle is centered on a warm yellow-orange field. Four small rectangular inset paintings occupy the corners, each depicting abstract objects on colored backgrounds. The entire scene is enclosed by a complex border consisting of green, white, and red stripes, finished with an outer black-and-yellow sawtooth pattern.
coreVisualRelationships: Central blue disk as the primary focal point
Four corner vignettes balancing the central mass
Concentric rectangular borders framing the internal elements
Hand-painted texture unifying disparate geometric shapes
coreInvariants: The central blue disk must contain a visible spiral stroke
The border must include a repeating sawtooth or triangle pattern
The color palette must prioritize primary yellow, blue, and red with green accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large blue circle occupies approximately 60% of the central canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue spiral disk acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central blue disk, moves outward to the corner vignettes, and is finally contained by the rhythmic sawtooth border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The yellow-orange field acts as active negative space, separating the central disk from the corner elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with a hand-painted, slightly uneven value distribution.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are broken across visual gaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-painted face used for all text elements to maintain folk-art consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, bracketed serif structure.
Captures the naive, manual feel of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hand-painted folk-art background with a large blue spiral disk centered on a yellow field, four small rectangular vignettes in the corners, and a multi-layered border including a sawtooth pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted, black, high-contrast serif lettering in uppercase, using irregular spacing and fragmented word placement at the top and bottom of the central disk.

verificationChecks: Is the central disk a blue spiral?
Are there four distinct corner vignettes?
Is the border a multi-colored sawtooth pattern?
Is the text hand-painted with irregular spacing?
Is the overall style naive and folk-art inspired?

mustRedesign: Do not use standard font kerning
Ensure the spiral is visible in the central circle
postGenerationChecks: Verify the sawtooth border is present
Ensure the text looks manually applied
Confirm the quadrant layout is balanced but imperfect
recipe.reuseFormula: Folk-art layout = (Central Spiral Disk + 4 Corner Vignettes) * (Multi-layered Sawtooth Border) + (Hand-painted Irregular Serif Typography)
